metadata.title: GloBI
metadata.description: A sampled set of GloBI species interactions. Directed links group equivalent relationship names; sourceInteractionTypes preserve the original GloBI labels where they differ.
metadata.selection: Original example expanded with distinct typed interaction pairs from up to 1,000 GloBI API rows for each of 20 source taxa, retrieved 2026-09-22. Generic interactsWith rows were omitted. Inverse feeding links were reversed, synonymous feeding and visit labels were merged, and broader hostOf duplicates were removed.
metadata.naming: Node IDs use English common names where established; otherwise an English taxon group plus the scientific name. Common names were checked against GBIF species records; some original example names were retained.
